intro.text: A city that is home to the Hall of Judgment, where the Taisha meet.
A city of Lossand, governed like the rest of the nation by the Taishin, most of whom live there, and policed by the trackts.

description.text: Its buildings are permanent ones, and sand masters helped to raise many of them.
Lonzare is the city's Darksider quarter.
It stands on the Ry'DoAli River on the southern side of the Dayside continent, roughly midway between the center and the coast.
